nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement the terminal-side sequence-safe attachment primitive defined in markdown/TERMINAL_SESSION_PERSISTENCE_FUNDAMENTAL_SOLUTION.md with RED-to-GREEN Rust proof.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY src-tauri/src/terminal/output_hub.rs, src-tauri/src/terminal/service.rs, src-tauri/src/terminal/tests.rs, and src-tauri/src/terminal/mod.rs if compilation requires it. First add focused tests that fail on the current byte-only hub. Then implement monotonic u64 output sequences per session, bounded history carrying exact available start/end sequence ranges, subscriber-first attachment snapshots, replay-after-sequence, and explicit replay-gap information when requested output has been evicted. Preserve existing raw attach behavior for current callers or update all callers within these owned files. Return exact RED and GREEN commands, exit statuses, changed-file list, and test names.
SCOPE: Own exactly the named terminal files. Read daemon files only for compatibility. Never edit other files, never revert unrelated changes, never commit.
VERIFY: Run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml terminal::output_hub --lib and cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml terminal::tests --lib. New tests must fail if sequences are removed or snapshot-before-subscribe ordering returns.
STOP WHEN: Owned source and tests are complete, both GREEN commands exit 0, and no file outside scope changed.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement independent Ferryx daemon executable entrypoint and checked launch-agent control using RED-to-GREEN tests, as defined in markdown/TERMINAL_SESSION_PERSISTENCE_FUNDAMENTAL_SOLUTION.md.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY src-tauri/src/main.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/launchd.rs, and src-tauri/tests/daemon_persistence_contract.rs. Make ferryx --daemon run DaemonServer headlessly without constructing a Tauri GUI; ordinary invocation must keep GUI startup. Refactor minimally for testable argument routing. Make launchd installation/uninstallation surface launchctl failures instead of discarding them while preserving internal compatibility identifier com.rorca.daemon. Add a deterministic test proving the daemon CLI selection without a window and no fixed sleep/poll loop; use an exact readiness/cancellation signal. Report RED and GREEN commands with exit codes and files changed.
SCOPE: Own exactly the three named files. You may read server/protocol code for integration only. Do not edit other files, do not commit, do not revert unrelated changes.
VERIFY: Run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test daemon_persistence_contract -- --test-threads=1 and cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin ferryx. Both must exit 0 after changes.
STOP WHEN: Headless daemon selection and checked launchd management are test-covered, verified, and no outside-scope files are modified.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement the frontend terminal restore coordinator defined in markdown/TERMINAL_SESSION_PERSISTENCE_FUNDAMENTAL_SOLUTION.md, test-first, without changing terminal IPC/transport APIs yet.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY ui/src/App.tsx, ui/src/state/hmrWorkspaceState.ts, ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts, ui/src/App.test.tsx, ui/src/state/workspaceStore.hmrRetention.test.tsx, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts, plus new ui/src/state/workspaceRestore.ts and ui/src/state/workspaceRestore.test.tsx if needed. Replace the unsafe one-bit restore guard with a per-workspace idle/loading/restored/failed coordinator safe under React StrictMode cleanup. Preserve stable local session and pane mappings. Reconcile known backendSessionId values against live IDs, retain live sessions, explicitly mark missing sessions lost/exited, and remove automatic respawn of lost daemon sessions. HMR recovery must make zero spawn and zero close calls. Add regression tests that fail on current StrictMode and auto-respawn behavior before implementation. Report RED and GREEN commands, test names, and file changes.
SCOPE: Own only the listed UI restore/persistence files and new workspaceRestore files. Read terminal transport for types only. Do not edit any other files; never commit or revert unrelated changes.
VERIFY: Run bun run --cwd ui test -- src/App.test.tsx src/state/workspaceStore.hmrRetention.test.tsx src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts and bun run --cwd ui build; both must exit 0 after implementation.
STOP WHEN: StrictMode-safe no-respawn restoration is implemented with tests that demonstrate zero HMR spawn/close and no outside-scope edits.
